paraphrase: O Kṛṣṇa, let the royal swan of my mind enter the cage of your lotus feet this very day; at the time the life-breath departs, when the throat is choked by phlegm, wind and bile, how could I remember you?
speaker: Kulaśekhara

original.text: kṛṣṇa tvadīya-pada-paṅkaja-pañjarāntam adyaiva me viśatu mānasa-rāja-haṃsaḥ | prāṇa-prayāṇa-samaye kapha-vāta-pittaiḥ kaṇṭhāvarodhana-vidhau smaraṇaṃ kutas te ||

paraphrase: I have no attachment to dharma, to heaps of wealth or to enjoyment of pleasures; let whatever must be, be, according to my former deeds; this alone I ask, O Lord, in birth after birth: let there be unwavering devotion to your two lotus feet.
speaker: Kulaśekhara

original.text: nāsthā dharme na vasu-nicaye naiva kāmopabhoge yad bhāvyaṃ tad bhavatu bhagavan pūrva-karmānurūpam | etat prārthyaṃ mama bahumataṃ janma-janmāntare 'pi tvat-pādāmbhoruha-yuga-gatā niścalā bhaktir astu ||
